claims.evidence: Box and manual confirm model D750, but no shot shows a serial number, import sticker, or region marking to confirm 'American used' origin.
No photo shows the actual camera body, lens glass, or mount; only closed/partially opened boxes and bubble wrap are visible.
No power-on, shutter-fire, LCD display, or sensor shot is present; functionality cannot be judged from packaging alone.
Photo 0 box label and Photo 1 user manual both clearly show 'D750'.

risks.risk: Body may not actually be inside the box (empty-box or swapped-item risk)
risks.proof: Clear photo/video of the camera body itself, showing lens mount, sensor, and serial number matching the box
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified contents, worst case treat as box-only / no confirmed working body

risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count from camera menu or a shutter-count app screenshot
risks.if_unproven: price as high-use body (worst case wear)

risks.risk: Lens (Nikkor 50) and Zhiyun gimbal condition/completeness not confirmed, and not mentioned in seller's text though visible in photos
risks.proof: Photos of lens glass (front/rear) and gimbal unit powered on with camera mounted
risks.if_unproven: price body only, exclude lens/gimbal value until shown working

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card) not shown
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together with the body
risks.if_unproven: price as body-only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Cosmetic/functional damage hidden under packaging or wrap
risks.proof: Unboxed photo of full body from multiple angles, screen on, no cracks/corrosion
risks.if_unproven: price at worst-case cosmetic condition (heavy wear assumed)

proof_requests: Photo of the actual camera body outside the box, showing lens mount, LCD, and serial number
Power-on photo/video showing live view or shutter count on screen
Photo of lens front/rear elements for fungus/scratches
Photo of Zhiyun gimbal powered on with camera mounted
Photo of all accessories (battery, charger, cables, memory card) laid out together
response.reason: Model identity (Nikon D750) is confirmed by box and manual, so it can be priced, but since body condition, functionality, and included accessories are all unverifiable from the photos, it must be priced at worst case until proof is supplied.
